title: Implement GET /api/health endpoint on Express
description: Implement a health check endpoint on the Express scraping server. Used by the Next.js app to verify the scraping sidecar is running before attempting crawls.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/health returns 200 with `{ status: 'ok', timestamp: number }`
Next.js app can call this endpoint to verify the scraper is available

steps.details: Add `app.get('/api/health', (req, res) => { res.json({ status: 'ok', timestamp: Date.now() }); });` to the Express server. This should already be a stub from TASK-6 — implement it now.
Run `curl http://localhost:3001/api/health`. Confirm response is `{"status":"ok","timestamp":...}` with HTTP 200.

technicalNotes: The Next.js app should call /api/health before triggering a crawl and surface a helpful error message if the scraper is not running.
